button.label: Evaluate
button.supertip: Turns the selected text, or the current paragraph, into a Calcpad expression and shows its result. Each selected paragraph becomes one expression. Text written as {= ... } anywhere in the document is picked up too. With the keyboard shortcut on a result, it shows the source instead.

button.label: Recalculate
button.supertip: Recalculates every Calcpad expression: main text first, then text boxes, notes, headers and footers. Later expressions use variables defined earlier.

button.label: Calcpad Block
button.supertip: Keeps the selected paragraphs (or the current one) together as one multi-line Calcpad script, drawn by Calcpad: comments, headings, #if, loops, macros, plots and tables. On an empty line it starts an empty block to type into. You can also type a line with only {= , the script, and a line with only } . (Evaluate on a pasted script instead turns its headings and text into Word paragraphs.)

button.label: Block to Text
button.supertip: Replaces the Calcpad block at the cursor with Word content: its headings and text become Word paragraphs with the values inline, and only plots, tables and #if/loops stay in Calcpad blocks. Evaluate does this by itself when you paste a Calcpad script.

button.label: Edit Source
button.supertip: Shows the Calcpad source of the result at the cursor so you can change it. Click outside it, or press Alt+Shift+Enter, to evaluate.

button.label: Cancel
button.supertip: Stops a calculation running in the background, or a math font being downloaded. Results already in the document keep their old values; Recalculate calculates them again. Esc does the same while a calculation runs.

dynamicMenu.supertip: Lists the expressions that failed. Pick one to go to it; the error message is shown as you point at it.

button.label: Next Error
button.supertip: Moves the cursor to the next expression that failed. Its error message is shown in the status bar and as the expression's title.

dropDown.label: Decimals
dropDown.supertip: Number of decimals in results. Calcpad keeps significant figures for small values.

checkBox.label: Substitute values
checkBox.supertip: Show the equation again with the values put in, before the result.

dropDown.label: Math font
dropDown.supertip: The font of all equations in this document (Word's own math font setting). A free font that isn't installed yet can be downloaded and installed for you, without administrator rights.

checkBox.label: Plain Word math
checkBox.supertip: Off: Calcpad look, with variable names in blue. On: plain black Word equations.
